title: 听力挑战 · 澄清误解

rounds.speaker: 朋友
rounds.line: It was you who told everyone about my plan, wasn't it?
rounds.lineCn: 是你把我的计划告诉了所有人,对吗?

grammar.name: It is/was ... who ... 强调句
grammar.note: 强调句型强调人时用 who,强调物时用 that。

options.text: It was not me. It was the assistant.
options.feedback: 用强调句澄清事实,指出真正的人。

options.text: Yes, I will tell everyone again.
options.feedback: 承认错误行为还要再做,回应不当。

options.text: The plan is very important to me.
options.feedback: 回避关键问题,没有澄清是否泄密。

rounds.speaker: 经理
rounds.line: I thought you had already finished the monthly report by now.
rounds.lineCn: 我以为你到现在已经完成月度报告了。

grammar.name: It is ... that ... 强调句
grammar.note: It is the data section that... 强调报告还没完成的环节。

options.text: It is the data section that still needs work.
options.feedback: 强调句说明未完成的部分,澄清现状。

options.text: I have never seen the monthly report.
options.feedback: 否认看过报告,与项目事实矛盾。

options.text: The report is about the new system.
options.feedback: 谈报告内容,没有回应完成情况。

rounds.speaker: 同事
rounds.line: So you refused to help them with the move, right?
rounds.lineCn: 所以你拒绝帮他们搬家,对吧?

grammar.name: 强调句表原因
grammar.note: It was the deadline that... 强调导致拒绝的原因是截止日期。

options.text: It was the deadline that made me say no.
options.feedback: 强调句说明拒绝的真正原因,澄清误解。

options.text: I will refuse them again tomorrow.
options.feedback: 火上浇油,没有澄清反而加剧误会。

options.text: The move is happening next week.
options.feedback: 谈搬家时间,没有说明拒绝原因。
